title: Rock City Motel PMS & Direct-Booking Site
summary: Full-stack PMS and direct-booking site for a 16-room motel—modernizing paper ops with a live room dashboard, multi-channel intake, and direct Stripe payments to bypass third-party fees.
problem: A 16-room motel suffered from inefficient paper operations, double-booking risks, and high third-party online travel agency commission fees on guest bookings.
approach: I built an end-to-end TypeScript PMS using React 19, Fastify, and PostgreSQL with EXCLUDE constraints for ACID transaction guarantees, paired with a direct Stripe payment integration.
outcome: Deployed as a live production system powering daily motel operations and capturing direct online bookings commission-free.
designChoices: End-to-End TypeScript: Enforced strict interfaces across frontend and Fastify API to eliminate truthiness bugs and catch errors before runtime.
PostgreSQL Concurrency & Transactions: Leveraged ACID transactions and EXCLUDE constraints to prevent data corruption and make double-bookings structurally impossible.
Dual-Database Bridge: Isolated local LAN staff operations from the public cloud booking site (Hetzner/Vercel) using an explicit import-on-assign pattern.
Fork-on-Edit Data Pattern: Resolved a live walk-in guest bug by forking guest records on edit rather than mutating a shared template row.
Direct Stripe Integration: Integrated PaymentIntents for public bookings to bypass third-party online travel agency commission fees.
